messages:
Ravi: initiating blue->green for router-proxy v2026.04.12-green, planned staged 12% -> 25% over 30m window. Change window 01:00-01:45 UTC. release notes: https://confluence.redwood/router-proxy/2026.04.12 :rocket:
Deploy-bot: Deploy job started (job=klm456). Command: `rd-deploy start --service router-proxy --version v2026.04.12-green --strategy bluegreen --staged 0.12 --ramp-to 0.25 --ramp-duration 30m`
Deploy-bot: Router queued initial set-weight: `routerctl set-weight router-proxy green 0.12`
Maya: noticing slight increase in connection errors in ap-northeast1 (tcp reset counts up ~0.05%). Small but correlated to new variant.
Theo: pause the automated ramp. Hold at 12%. Let's do a precision drain test on a single AZ to validate connection handling before region-wide roll.
infra-bot: Executing AZ targeted drain: `routerctl drain-az router-proxy green az-1-ap-northeast1 --grace 45s`
Deploy-bot: AZ drain in progress for az-1-ap-northeast1. Observing connection counts and failovers.
Maya: during AZ drain, we see retries spike briefly but no persistent 5xx. Connection resets decrease after drain completes.
Ravi: good. Proceed with staggered cutover: increase green to 20% in us/ eu, keep ap-northeast at 12% and monitor for 15m. Command: `routerctl set-weight router-proxy green 0.20 --region us-central1,eu-west1`
Deploy-bot: Region weights updated: us-central1 green=0.20, eu-west1 green=0.20, ap-northeast1 green=0.12 (held).
Theo: add temporary route-level retry backoff tweak for green in ap-northeast to reduce chattiness: `routerctl set-policy router-proxy retry-backoff 200ms --variant green --region ap-northeast1`
infra-bot: Policy applied.
Maya: after tweaks, ap-northeast metrics stable; connection resets back to baseline. No further action required there.
Ravi: OK to continue ramp to 25% globally in 10m if metrics remain green. I'll update release notes: "staggered AZ drain validated; ap-northeast held and tuned; proceeding to full ramp if stable."
Deploy-bot: Noted. Monitoring alerts set: p95, connection-reset-rate, and 5xx.
Theo: leave this thread open for 45m watch. If any region crosses thresholds, we'll auto-pause and evaluate rollback/region-exclude.
Ravi: thanks team, rolling forward in 10m if stable.
